title: Tour: Phone System
blurb: Your Luubu Phone numbers, call routing, voicemail and text back.

steps.title: Open Settings
steps.body: Click **Settings** at the bottom of the left menu.

steps.title: Open Phone System
steps.body: Click **Phone System** in the Settings menu.

steps.title: First time here?
steps.body: Phone numbers come through **Luubu Phone**. If you see **Your phone system requires configuration**, email hello@luubu.com and we will switch it on.

steps.title: Your numbers
steps.body: **Phone Numbers** lists every number on your account. Use the three-dot menu on a number to change how it handles calls.

steps.title: Voicemail and text back
steps.body: The voice settings hold your voicemail greeting and **Missed Call Text Back**.

steps.title: Number pools
steps.body: Number pools are for call tracking on your website. Most businesses do not need them.

steps.title: What next
steps.body: Next: try **Set up your phone number** from the Guide.
